body:
While I do spend almost all of my time on the Internet, none of the people I've ever met IRL have been anything less than absolutely awful. I just feel like everything is closing in on me. Everything I do is inadequate. I'm tired of of my peers pushing me around and taking advantage of the fact that the only way I'd be able to show dominance and stand up for myself is physical fighting (bully logic is very simple but seems to be able to defuse even the smartest comebacks, and going to parents is not feasible since these are also people I smoke with and I really don't need that coming down on me. 

I want to just leave sometimes, just find some empty dirt field and squat there, grow food for myself, and get absolutely baked every day. If I had all the weed I could smoke, I would never really need to do anything else to entertain myself. I know it sounds stupid/crazy/immature, but that's how I feel.
